name: AWS Trn2.48xlarge: 20.8 FP8 PFLOPS (16-chip instance)
methodology: Vendor-published instance specification. 16 Trainium2 chips in a 4x4 2D torus with NeuronLink-v3 at 1024 GB/s/chip. FP8 peak compute. Also: 10.7 PFLOPS FP16/BF16/TF32, 41 PFLOPS sparse, 2.9 PFLOPS FP32.
notes:
This is a vendor-published peak compute specification, not a measured inference throughput. The 20.8 PFLOPS is the theoretical FP8 peak for the 16-chip instance. No inference throughput (tokens/sec) is published by AWS for Trainium2. The per-chip FP8 figure of 1300 TFLOPS is derived: 20.8 PFLOPS / 16 chips.
